commit_message_convention: [feat]/[fix]/[improvement] followed by a concise Chinese description
policy: Preserve the existing CPU, production SoC, constraints, firmware and build flow.
Develop experimental RTL and software through separate modules and build entries.
Validate each stage before enabling it in the experimental board top.
Do not begin cache work before the video stage; ELF loading follows cache evaluation.

stages.name: Freeze known-good CPU
stages.acceptance: Original RTL unchanged; original full regression passes.

stages.name: RV32M and independent ISA tests
stages.acceptance: All eight operations, edge and random vectors, two PC styles, forwarding, precise trap and IRQ, no duplicated MMIO.

stages.name: DDR2 and DMA
stages.acceptance: MIG calibration, CPU backpressure, byte enables, DMA bounds and arbitration; board memory sweep and CRC.

stages.name: VGA text mode and PS/2 keyboard
stages.acceptance: 640x480 timing, text cells and cursor, PS/2 parity and scan-code decoding, board typing.
pending_acceptance: Physical VGA display: monitor not connected
Physical keyboard input: deferred by user on 2026-10-06

stages.name: PtrocOS TTY and shell
stages.acceptance: Editable lines, command dispatch, UART and VGA/keyboard TTY, scheduler remains responsive.
pending_acceptance: Physical VGA and keyboard acceptance remains deferred as recorded in stage 4

stages.name: SD and FatFs
stages.acceptance: SD initialization and block I/O, FAT mount and file read, removal/error handling.
pending_acceptance: FPGA and UART restored; storage firmware loaded. Real SD mount/known-file CRC pending: controller reports no-card
Real card presence, SD card-detect/power polarity, electrical timing and card compatibility
Physical keyboard input remains deferred by user; VGA monitor is not connected

stages.name: ls/cat/hexdump
stages.acceptance: Real directory listing, file display and bounded hexadecimal output.
pending_acceptance: Real SD directory listing, raw file bytes and hexdump against local original: controller reports no-card
Physical VGA/keyboard acceptance remains deferred as recorded in stage 4

stages.name: DDR framebuffer and VGA graphics
stages.acceptance: DMA scanout, FIFO underrun detection, safe frame swap and concurrent CPU access.
pending_acceptance: Physical VGA graphics display: monitor not connected
Physical keyboard input remains deferred by user as recorded in stage 4

stages.name: BMP and WAV
stages.acceptance: Validated format limits, SD streaming, image display and audio playback on board.
pending_acceptance: Real SD BMP/WAV playback: controller reports no-card
Physical VGA display: monitor not connected
J8 analog waveform and listening test
Physical keyboard input: deferred by user

stages.name: Custom video and Bad Apple
stages.acceptance: Documented asset format and host converter, bounded buffers, timed playback and dropped-frame accounting.
pending_acceptance: Real SD Bad Apple playback: controller reports no-card
Physical VGA display: monitor not connected
J8 analog waveform and listening test
Physical keyboard input: deferred by user

stages.name: Evaluate I/D cache
stages.acceptance: Measure stalls first; if implemented, preserve MMIO ordering and DMA coherence.

stages.name: ELF loader
stages.acceptance: Validate ELF32 RISC-V headers and segment ranges, zero BSS, define process/runtime handoff.
